projects.name: Project Areas
details: Personalized, Omnichannel outreach, rewards, gap closure and data
analysis into one user-friendly engagement platform.
Key  Contributions:
• Collaborated with cross‑functional teams (product, engineering, QA, and
business stakeholders) to translate business problems into data-driven
analytical requirements and insights.
• Designed, maintained, and prioritized analytical backlogs including
data requests, dashboards, reports, and ad‑hoc analyses aligned with
business objectives.
• Analyzed structured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and
anomalies, supporting sprint goals, product improvements, and
operational decision-making.
• Broke down complex business questions into actionable analytical
tasks, defining data sources, transformations, and calculation logic for
accurate analysis.
• Partnered with development and QA teams to test data pipelines,
reports, and dashboards, ensuring metrics were consistent with
business definitions.
